gaps.what_is_wrong: L1 refund approval limit is INR 5,000 in 3.1 and INR 2,500 in 5.3.
Escalations go to 'the relevant manager' with no named role or contact, and no response time.
Refunds are processed 'promptly' with no number of days.
No procedure for disputed payments or chargebacks, although several payment methods are listed.
Records are kept for 'a reasonable period' with no retention duration.
Support is closed on Sundays but urgent Sunday complaints go to an on-call agent that is not defined (who, how reached, what counts as urgent).
No fallback approver when the team lead or finance department is unavailable.
